fullPassage: Dictionary definitions are constantly revised to keep up with our changing uses and knowledge. In Roman times, "addicts" were people who were unable to pay their debts and gave themselves as slaves to their creditors. The word eventually came to be associated with drug dependency: one becomes a slave to one's addiction. The word "husband" originally referred to being a homeowner; it had nothing to do with being married. But because owning your own property made it more likely you'd find a mate, the word eventually came to mean a male who has been wed. On November 5th, 1605, Guy Fawkes tried to blow up the British Parliament. He was captured and put to death. Loyalists burned his effigy, which they nicknamed the "guy." Centuries later, the word lost its negative connotation and a musical named Guys and Dolls ran on Broadway. In American slang, bad means good, cool means great, and wicked means excellent. If you could transport yourself one hundred years into the future, you'd find yourself confused by your great-grandchildren's speech because language itself is an ever-changing reflection of human invention.

Guy Fawkes는 영국 의회를 폭파하는 데 성공해 영웅이 되었다.
미국 속어에서 'bad'는 언제나 나쁜 것을 의미한다.

questions.passage: Dictionary definitions are constantly revised to keep up with our changing uses and knowledge. In Roman times, "addicts" were people who were unable to pay their debts and gave themselves as slaves to their creditors. The word eventually came to be associated with drug dependency: one becomes a slave to one's addiction. The word "husband" originally referred to being a homeowner; it had nothing to do with being married. But because owning your own property made it more likely you'd find a mate, the word eventually came to mean a male who has been wed. On November 5th, 1605, Guy Fawkes tried to blow up the British Parliament. He was captured and put to death. Loyalists burned his effigy, which they nicknamed the "guy." Centuries later, the word lost its negative connotation and a musical named Guys and Dolls ran on Broadway. In American slang, bad means good, cool means great, and wicked means excellent. If you could transport yourself one hundred years into the future, you'd find yourself confused by your great-grandchildren's speech because language itself is an ever-changing reflection of human invention.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ① constantly revised / ② lost negative connotation / ③ owning property → find a mate / ④ 미래엔 혼란
det.analysis:
✅ ① 정의가 변화하는 쓰임·지식에 맞춰 개정된다는 첫 문장과 일치
✅ ② 'guy'가 부정적 어감을 잃고 뮤지컬 제목에까지 쓰인 흐름과 일치
✅ ③ 재산 소유가 배우자를 만날 가능성을 높였고 그것이 husband 의미 변화로 이어졌다는 본문과 일치
❌ ④ 언어가 '끊임없이 변하는(ever-changing)' 반영이라 미래로 가면 후손 말에 혼란스러울 것이라 했으므로 '거의 변하지 않아 쉽게 소통'은 반대 ← 정답
det.tip: 언어는 ever-changing → 미래엔 소통 혼란

ch: 사전의 정의는 변화하는 언어 사용과 지식을 반영하여 개정된다.
'guy'는 시간이 흐르며 부정적 어감을 잃고 널리 쓰이게 되었다.
재산 소유가 배우자를 만날 가능성을 높인 것이 'husband'의 의미 변화와 관련된다.
필자는 미래에도 언어가 거의 변하지 않아 후손과 쉽게 소통할 수 있다고 본다.

det.analysis:
✅ ① gave: gave themselves as slaves — 과거시제, 적절

det.tip: 동명사구 주어 + 과거 문맥 → made

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오.
"그들은 자신을 채권자에게 노예로 내주었다"
[조건] (1) as, creditors, gave, slaves, their, themselves, to 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 7단어로 쓸 것 (영어로)

det.korean: gave themselves as slaves to their creditors = 자신을 채권자에게 노예로 내주었다
det.analysis:
핵심 동사는 gave(주었다)예요. 목적어로 '자신을'을 뜻하는 재귀대명사 themselves를 써요(주어와 목적어가 같을 때). 그다음 'as slaves(노예로서)'로 자격을 나타내고, 'to their creditors(그들의 채권자에게)'로 방향을 나타내요.

순서: gave(주었다) → themselves(자신을) → as slaves(노예로서) → to their creditors(채권자에게).

완성: gave themselves as slaves to their creditors (7단어)
det.tip: give oneself as A to B = 자신을 B에게 A로서 내주다
